dmzconfighalo.command.color.reset: Halo color reset to the original.
dmzconfighalo.command.color.invalid: Invalid color. Use a 6-digit hex code (e.g. FFD700 or #FFD700) or "reset".
dmzconfighalo.command.formheight.set: Halo height for form "%s" set to %s pixels.
dmzconfighalo.command.formheight.empty: You have no per-form halo heights. Transform and use /dmzhalo config formheight current <pixels>.
dmzconfighalo.command.formheight.noform: You have no active transformation. Transform first, or use /dmzhalo config formheight <form> <pixels>.
dmzconfighalo.command.formheight.invalid: Invalid form name. Use only letters, numbers, _ - and . (up to 48 characters).
